HV-R3-RESULT-PART 004
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:352; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:545; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:576; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:599; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:600; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1934; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1952; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-011-AC008.
Defect: The error catalog defines evidence_corrupt as public HTTP 500 and immediately lists it among internal codes never returned by a public route. HvOutputEvent names errorCode and closedStatus while the stream wire events use code and status. The GetHvRequest sequence returns 200 after a recorded read without the newly specified decompression-failure response; the Submit sequence likewise omits admission corruption. GzipCodec users still omit the added brief and probe readers.
Evidence: A corrupt current-run chunk is required to produce 500 by 599 and the GetHvRequest unit, but the complete request sequence at 1952 to 1953 has only the successful 200 branch after the read is recorded. A client generated from 545 cannot read the stream error field emitted by 576 under the stated DTO shape. These are externally observable contracts, not wording polish. The added corruption cases have not been propagated to every definition and response sequence as R2-F10 required.
Change to PASS: Choose one canonical wire shape for each output event and one public/internal error classification, then make DTOs, route responses, sequences, use-case alternates, client contracts and component user lists refer to it consistently. Explicitly draw the admission and last-output corruption responses. Extend the existing named corruption test to assert the exact event field and HTTP status on each affected surface, preserving audited access and server-fault attribution.

UNKNOWN list: empty. Operator-decision FAIL list: empty. D-03 remains the already identified operator approval of the listed foundation amendments; it is not a new missing decision or a reason to waive these implementer repairs.

Required closure, one entry per prior item:
- R2-F01 PASS: HvProbeOutcome guards current configuration before every close, failure, shutdown and expiry mutation; amendment 1055,1087,1124,1431 and FR-003-AC006.
- R2-F02 PASS: Startup NONCE excludes a configuration with a settled probe; corrupt probes do not retry automatically after restart. Amendment 152,1431,1479 and FR-003-AC007.
- R2-F03 FAIL: Renewal, lease release, accepted-result precedence and artifact sweep rechecks are repaired, but attempt/execution DTO data flow and terminal field writers remain incomplete: R3-F04. Worker caller propagation is also incomplete: R3-F05.
- R2-F04 PASS: P5 uses configured or pooled default for artifact review in H3; foundation pin retirement is H0. Both TODOs and 1621/20.4 agree.
- R2-F05 PASS: R-31 and V-4 use all immutable admitted responses, including those later Closed; score-only DISAGREE closure races have a named test. Amendment 173 and FR-010-AC010.
- R2-F06 PASS: NotGraded/reason is in the result shape and every response FAIL/UNKNOWN is an HvFinding even when Closed. Removal preserves those rows; FR-021-AC002/006.
- R2-F07 PASS: A-05 explicitly retires foundation 6.7 grader sequences and the obsolete 403; amended internal unit uses the stated origin/state conflict contract. Amendment 183,1247.
- R2-F08 FAIL: Internal readers now call RecordRead, but probe access is not durable before consumption and Submit replay is missing from the universal boundary: R3-F02/F03.
- R2-F09 FAIL: Finalize itself preserves Fail refusals and restarts state checks. Worker/sweep/process exits still claim successful transitions or continue after refusal: R3-F05.
- R2-F10 FAIL: Result compression and corrupt payload recovery now have bounded server-fault paths. Public/internal error classification, stream fields and every read response sequence remain inconsistent: R3-F06.
- R2-F11 PASS: All clause-ending test groups are retained. Independent 1269 checks pass; 146 occurrences/145 distinct names and all 63 records match.
- R2-F12 PASS: FR-010-AC007 is H7; FR-012-AC007 is H2; ReadinessProbeVerdict/HvProbeOutcome/V-1 are H3; P7 has EventStreamControllerCitesItsChangeStreamRequirement in H0. All 138 phase bindings are unique.
- F04 PASS: The stale-configuration probe failure, shutdown and expiry guard is centralized; same evidence as R2-F01.
- F10 PASS: Foundation model-grade sequences/error retirement now explicit; same evidence as R2-F07.
- F11 PASS: All accepted response findings survive closure and evidence removal; same evidence as R2-F06.
- F12 PASS: Overall verdict is validated against immutable admitted responses; same evidence as R2-F05.
- F18 FAIL: Separate HostileReview context and configured/default agent are correct, but its complete execution/terminal DTO contract is still missing: R3-F04.
- U02 PASS: All 138 ACs have one explicit production phase with stated H1 harness and live-check distinctions; same evidence as R2-F12.

Regression audit of items round 2 had passed:
- F01 PASS: quiet single-line flush plus gated streaming test remain.
- F02 PASS: notification cursor and durable inbox are one atomic replacement; delivery is at least once.
- F03 PASS: effective configuration changes version/requalify; stale updates use expectedStateVersion.
- F05 PASS: probe run exit is separate from Review finalization.
- F06 PASS: V-6 requires the completed reviewer Chore and every normalized reviewer record.
- F07 PASS: result digest excludes itself; evidence hashes bind stored payloads.
- F08 PASS: incident row commits before triage dispatch; filing is idempotent and retried.
- F09 PASS: P1 distinguishes checked projection from unsatisfied live worker criterion.
- F13 PASS: one overall predicate applies to per-turn, holistic and admitted-response results.
- F14 PASS: RecordHvRunStartCommand writes start metadata after actual launch.
- F15 PASS: cancel found at Close goes to Canceled and releases turns.
- F16 PASS: removed evidence gives explicit retrieval/stream outcomes while hashes and findings remain.
- F17 PASS: VI-05 explicitly requires a measured H1 storage workload; codec decode is not substituted.
- F19 PASS: worker/process-tree containment and termination on owner loss remain explicit without an execution timeout.
- F20 PASS: plugin idempotency key and child identifiers use bounded hashing/truncation rules.
- F21 PASS: conditional Fail cannot overwrite Completed; R3-F01 is a separate unguarded sweep path, not a reversal of that repaired command.
- U01 PASS: server GitHub activity proves ordinary pushes, including the eight pushes after the prior audit.

Structured what-if pass, one entry per proposed functional requirement:
- FR-MCP-HVPIPE-001: Concurrent expectedStateVersion updates, enabled/configuration changes, stale readiness display and every reviewer field writer checked. Current configuration/probe writers are explicit.
- FR-MCP-HVPIPE-002: Cross-agent/family aliases, submitter/author exclusion, disjoint concurrent submissions, wraparound and pool depletion checked; assignment remains transactional and bounded.
- FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003: Close/nonzero/launch failure/corruption/shutdown/expiry before and after reconfiguration or restart checked. Single outcome policy and settled-probe exclusion pass; audit rollback fails R3-F02.
- FR-MCP-HVPIPE-004: Empty scope, invalid range/endpoints, submitting-turn exclusion, snapshot immutability and concurrent overlapping submissions checked; replay projection fails R3-F03.
- FR-MCP-HVPIPE-005: Nonterminal, pending, already-reviewed, Chore/Other and no-independent-reviewer adm
